== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Dengar: the entry in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'' (November 1998), PDF page 48, cropped at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Image for [[Dengar (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: Decipher, [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0] (November 1998), PDF page 48, entry Dengar. Wiki copy: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive].
